k: Built-in addition handles negative numbers and small ranges without any special logic.

w: This problem tests basic syntax familiarity across languages rather than algorithmic skill. Edge cases: both inputs negative, one zero, or sum at boundary values. If constraints were near INT_MAX, you'd need 64-bit intermediates or overflow checks; here they're unnecessary.
